etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Middle English directorie, dyrectorye, from Medieval Latin dīrectōrium. Doublet of directorium.

definitions.definition: A list of names, addresses etc, of specific classes of people or organizations, often in alphabetical order or in some classification.
(computing) A structured listing of the names and characteristics of the files on a storage device.
(computing) A virtual container in a computer's file system, in which files and other directories may be stored. The files and subdirectories in a directory are usually related.

etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Middle English directorye, from Latin dīrectōrius.
